verdict.rationale: Asaas documents its own automatic notifications sent before and after the due date by email, WhatsApp, SMS or voice robot. It also offers overdue-charge recovery through Serasa negativation, alongside subscriptions and late-payment interest and fines. Together these cover the dunning and recovery-communication side of the story. There is no evidence of automatically retrying failed subscription card payments. missing for 10: automatic retry of failed subscription payments, configurable smart retry schedules, subscription-specific dunning workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
